Who We Are
Niewohner Entities is a family-owned operation based in Albion, Nebraska.
In 1954, Delbert and Marilee Niewohner bought a quarter of land and got to work. Delbert believed you could always do more than you thought if you put your mind to it. They taught their kids the same way.
Today, their four sons run the operation. The business has grown, but the foundation hasn’t changed.
We do the work right. We take care of the people doing it. And we keep building for what’s next.
